name: Amdocs
description: Enterprise BSS/OSS platform with deep telecom industry integration competing directly with Skyvera's CloudSense CPQ for Salesforce-native deployments.
strengths: Comprehensive end-to-end BSS ecosystem with billing, customer care, and revenue management
Established relationships with major telcos including Telstra across multiple product lines
Extensive customization capabilities and professional services delivery
weaknesses: Heavy on-premise legacy architecture requiring significant cloud migration investment vs Skyvera's native Salesforce design
Slower CPQ-specific innovation and slower quote-to-cash cycles compared to Salesforce-native solutions
Higher total cost of ownership and implementation complexity for mid-market telcos

name: NetCracker
description: Nokia-owned BSS platform with CPQ capabilities targeting telecom operators, competing with Skyvera while also competing with Telstra in adjacent telecom network software markets.
strengths: Strong Nokia integration for telecom network operations and service fulfillment alignment
Modern cloud-native architecture with microservices and API-first design
Deep industry expertise in complex telecom product packaging and pricing models
weaknesses: Limited native Salesforce integration and CRM interoperability compared to Skyvera's Salesforce-native approach
Smaller installed base in Salesforce-centric enterprise environments
Higher complexity in deployment and longer time-to-value for CPQ-focused implementations
